project_title: A Social-Media-Robust Lightweight Multi-Head Image Forensics System using Community Forensics-Small and SID-Set
final_goal: Build a lightweight multi-head image forensics prototype that classifies images as real/synthetic/tampered, localizes tampered regions, identifies coarse generator-family provenance, and generates template-based evidence explanations — all runnable on a single RTX 4090.

mask.description: Tampered region localization mask (conditional on tampered_score >= tau)

reason.description: Template-based evidence explanation combining class, family, and mask information

Community Forensics-Small.primary_role: Shared visual backbone pre-training and generator-family provenance head training
use_cases: shared backbone training with generator diversity
coarse provenance label construction from architecture metadata

SID-Set.primary_role: 3-way classification and tampered mask localization fine-tuning
SID-Set.size_note: train 210K + validation 30K (240K rows considered for initial implementation)

shared_backbone.role: Shared visual feature extraction for all heads

heads.name: Conditional Localization Head
heads.description: Activated only when tampered_score >= tau; predicts tampered region mask

heads.name: Evidence Aggregation Module
heads.description: Combines class/family/mask scores to produce template-based explanation

implementation_stages.name: Community Forensics-Small Binary Backbone
implementation_stages.goal: Reproduce binary real/fake detector; train shared backbone with generator diversity using generator-holdout validation

implementation_stages.name: Generator-Family Provenance Head
implementation_stages.goal: Add coarse provenance head on top of Stage 1 backbone using architecture metadata from CF-Small

implementation_stages.name: SID-Set Multi-Head Fine-Tuning
implementation_stages.goal: Fine-tune on SID-Set for 3-way classification and tampered mask localization; handle missing family labels via freeze/mask-out/mixed-batch

implementation_stages.name: Social-Media Robustness and Evidence Template
implementation_stages.goal: Add screenshot/text-overlay/sticker-overlay/recompression perturbations; measure robustness drop; output template-based explanation

evaluation_metrics.name: Tampered Mask IoU
evaluation_metrics.purpose: Overlap between predicted mask and ground-truth mask

evaluation_metrics.name: Perturbation Robustness Drop
evaluation_metrics.purpose: Performance degradation after social-media perturbations (Delta F1 / Delta IoU)

evaluation_metrics.name: Latency
evaluation_metrics.purpose: Inference time in ms/image on RTX 4090

evaluation_metrics.name: FPS
evaluation_metrics.purpose: Inference FPS at batch size 1 on RTX 4090

evaluation_metrics.name: Localization Activation Recall
evaluation_metrics.purpose: Fraction of true tampered images where localization head was activated

first_risks.name: Data Leakage
first_risks.description: Same generator appearing in both train and validation sets; must use generator-holdout validation

first_risks.name: Missing Family Labels in SID-Set
first_risks.description: SID-Set lacks family labels; apply freeze/mask-out/mixed-batch strategy for provenance head

first_risks.name: Conditional Localization False Negatives
first_risks.description: tau too high causes missed tampered images; set tau based on tampered recall

first_risks.name: Perturbation Robustness
first_risks.description: Social-media transformations may severely degrade performance; track Delta F1 and Delta IoU

first_risks.name: Reproducibility
first_risks.description: Must config-ize seed, dataset paths, output paths, and perturbation switches

guardrails: No access to .env, secrets, data, datasets, checkpoints, or outputs directories
No external network access from shell commands
All agent tasks must be small and reversible
